preserved: wave equation on an effective metric (kinematics)

maps.prior_work: Unruh 1981; Barcelo Liberati Visser 2005; Macher and Parentani 2009; Steinhauer 2019
maps.title: Acoustic horizon, black hole
maps.note: Temperature within 6 to 13 percent of kappa/2pi to kappa/Lambda 0.5; 0.2 of it at 1. A pumped flow has no negative heat capacity.
maps.break_point: kinematics: fitted temperature leaves 30 percent at kappa/Lambda 1.00. Dynamics: Einstein's equations are not obeyed by the flow: a pumped flow keeps kappa fixed, while a Schwarzschild hole's T = 1/(8 pi M) rises as it loses mass. Negative heat capacity has no counterpart here.
maps.metric: fitted temperature over kappa/2pi at kappa/Lambda up to 0.1
maps.bits_note: one bit is a placeholder for the sign of heat capacity lost in the round trip; the wave sector loses none at low kappa/Lambda

maps.break_point: Poiseuille flow leaves 5 percent at Womersley 1.5; xylem sits at 4.3e-04 and aorta at 13 to 20 (memory). Whole-branch exponent 2.3 misses Murray's 3: wood also carries load. Water under tension cavitates, a state blood has no counterpart for

maps.held_out: rounds to avalanche in a toy SPN
maps.shared_mechanism: shared bijection plus stretching; no shared key
memory_values: S-box and layer from memory; toy only
maps.title: Marbling, cipher diffusion
maps.note: Early diffusion rate carries (factor 1.28). The linear mix tops out at avalanche 0.28, and diffusion breaks the round trip.
maps.break_point: early diffusion carries over; the linear mix itself saturates at avalanche 0.28, under 0.5. Confusion does not carry: an area-preserving mix is linear, share 1.00 against 0.0000 for the SPN, so it gives no key security. Any molecular diffusion loses the round trip: 13.1 bits at sigma 0.1 cell against 0 for a cipher
maps.metric: factor between rounds to avalanche 0.45 and rounds read through the mixing law, toy 16 bit SPN
